subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: The harness shall bind and run the full ladder on fixture repos of at least three distinct stacks (Go plus two others) using only their manifests and the ecosystem defaults — with zero per-stack code in the harness itself.
rationale: technology-independence is a tested property, not a claim
fit_criterion: the fixture matrix is green in the harness's CI; inspection confirms stack-specific behavior lives only in manifest data and the ecosystem table
